description:
Follow-up to fz-9x7.41.4 (I4); same user word as its sibling: "we should shore up the gaps in I4, if they're necessary to continue." Filed at the end of fz-9e2.

fz_alloc_binview_from_static (ir_runtime.rs:1424) retains the static SharedBin and pushes a heap BinRef onto the off-heap chain on every evaluation. Once fz-9e2.4 makes a static buffer's refcount static, the view can be a static object, as a small literal already is (prim.rs, static_object_ref). Owner: Binary Handling (or GC by agreement).
title: A large binary literal is static data: no view, retain or BinRef is made at run time
